label: Alpine Range
summary: A mountain chain along a drawn line, grown by its rivers: a snowy crest branching into spurs, valleys cut up every flank, plains at its feet.

exposed.name: spine
exposed.label: Crest
exposed.help: The line the crest follows, drawn on the terrain.

exposed.name: seed
exposed.label: Seed
exposed.help: Another seed gives another chain along the same line.

exposed.name: height
exposed.label: Mountain height
exposed.help: How high the summits rise over the foot, in blocks.

exposed.name: base
exposed.label: Foot
exposed.help: The height of the plains at the chain's foot, in blocks.

exposed.name: width
exposed.label: Width
exposed.help: How wide the chain is from foot to foot, in blocks.

exposed.name: spurs
exposed.label: Spurs
exposed.help: How strongly side ridges run down the flanks.

exposed.name: erosion
exposed.label: Erosion
exposed.help: How long the rivers have cut their valleys: longer, deeper valleys reaching higher.

exposed.name: downcutting
exposed.label: Downcutting
exposed.help: High, deep narrow valleys and sharp ridges; low, broad valleys and rounded ridges.

exposed.name: snowline
exposed.label: Snow line
exposed.help: The height above which snow lies on open ground, in blocks.
